+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AggregateMetricStatsRequest:
+    metric_name: str
+    start_time: datetime
+    end_time: datetime
+    aggregation: str = "avg"
+    resource_filter: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+def _isoformat(dt: datetime) -> str:
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+
+
+def retrieve_aggregated_metric_stats(request: AggregateMetricStatsRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("DATADOG_API_KEY")
+    app_key = os.environ.get("DATADOG_APP_KEY")
+    site = os.environ.get("DATADOG_SITE", "datadoghq.com")
+    if not api_key or not app_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("DATADOG_API_KEY and DATADOG_APP_KEY are required")
+
+    url = f"https://api.{site}/api/v1/query"
+    query = request.metric_name
+    if request.resource_filter:
+        query = f"{query}{{{request.resource_filter}}}"
+
+    params = {
+        "from": int(request.start_time.timestamp()),
+        "to": int(request.end_time.timestamp()),
+        "query": f"{request.aggregation}:{query}",
+    }
+    headers = {"DD-API-KEY": api_key, "DD-APPLICATION-KEY": app_key}
+    response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    series = payload.get("series", [])
+    points = []
+    for item in series:
+        for point in item.get("pointlist", []):
+            ts_ms, value = point
+            if value is not None:
+                points.append({"timestamp": datetime.fromtimestamp(ts_ms / 1000, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat(), "value": value})
+
+    values = [p["value"] for p in points]
+    stats = {
+        "metric_name": request.metric_name,
+        "aggregation": request.aggregation,
+        "window_start": _isoformat(request.start_time),
+        "window_end": _isoformat(request.end_time),
+        "point_count": len(values),
+        "min": min(values) if values else None,
+        "max": max(values) if values else None,
+        "avg": (sum(values) / len(values)) if values else None,
+        "series": series,
+        "points": points,
+    }
+    return stats
+
+
+def build_default_request(metric_name: str, minutes: int = 60, aggregation: str = "avg") -> AggregateMetricStatsRequest:
+    end_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    start_time = end_time - timedelta(minutes=minutes)
+    return AggregateMetricStatsRequest(metric_name=metric_name, start_time=start_time, end_time=end_time, aggregation=aggregation)

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+DATADOG_API_BASE = "https://api.datadoghq.com"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MetricPoint:
+    timestamp: datetime
+    value: float
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MetricWindowResult:
+    metric: str
+    from_ts: int
+    to_ts: int
+    points: List[MetricPoint]
+    raw: Dict[str, Any]
+
+
+def _parse_iso8601(value: str) -> datetime:
+    if value.endswith("Z"):
+        value = value[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    return datetime.fromisoformat(value).astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+def _window_bounds(minutes: int, end_time: Optional[datetime] = None) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    end = end_time or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    start = end - timedelta(minutes=minutes)
+    return int(start.timestamp()), int(end.timestamp())
+
+
+def query_metric_window(
+    metric: str,
+    minutes: int = 60,
+    *,
+    aggregator: str = "avg",
+    end_time: Optional[datetime] = None,
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
+    app_key: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> MetricWindowResult:
+    api_key = api_key or os.getenv("DD_API_KEY")
+    app_key = app_key or os.getenv("DD_APP_KEY")
+    if not api_key or not app_key:
+        raise ValueError("DD_API_KEY and DD_APP_KEY are required for Datadog metric queries")
+
+    from_ts, to_ts = _window_bounds(minutes, end_time)
+    params = {
+        "from": from_ts,
+        "to": to_ts,
+        "query": f"{aggregator}:{metric}{{*}}",
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "DD-API-KEY": api_key,
+        "DD-APPLICATION-KEY": app_key,
+        "Accept": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.get(f"{DATADOG_API_BASE}/api/v1/query", params=params, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    series = payload.get("series", [])
+    points: List[MetricPoint] = []
+    for item in series:
+        for ts, value in item.get("pointlist", []) or []:
+            if ts is None or value is None:
+                continue
+            points.append(MetricPoint(timestamp=datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=timezone.utc), value=float(value)))
+    points.sort(key=lambda p: p.timestamp)
+    return MetricWindowResult(metric=metric, from_ts=from_ts, to_ts=to_ts, points=points, raw=payload)
+

+        "to": result.to_ts,
+        "points": [{"timestamp": p.timestamp.isoformat(), "value": p.value} for p in result.points],
+        "raw": result.raw,
+    }
